reason: A answers my actual objections: it tells me the nearest chain is over 20 miles away in 14 counties, admits brand-name drugs offset part of the loss, offers invoices I can verify and a meeting before May 1, and names a concrete ask (cost plus fill fee floor) with two pharmacies ready to drop the plan. B is full of placeholders, sentimental appeals, and unverifiable assertions that read like the annual complaint.
